records.purpose_and_limitations: Twenty-one candidate rows, all with reportable=0, whitelist=0 and classification=not_matched. The clinical Tempus report separately states that RNA analysis identified no gene rearrangements or reportable altered-splicing events. The candidate table contains additional call-level detail; these are not asserted to be clinically confirmed fusions. The file was supplied among Tempus materials associated with the resection DNA/RNA export; the exact export-to-library, aliquot, block and alignment-file link is not independently established. The source table declares no reference build or coordinate convention. Caller versions, parameters and precise support-field definitions are unavailable. No somatic/germline assignment, independent validation, reproducibility from published reads or treatment recommendation is inferred.
